title: P0: AnnounceTrustStore Debug derive leaks sealing seed
description: announce_store.rs derives Debug on AnnounceTrustStore, whose sealing_seed is Option<Zeroizing<[u8;32]>>. zeroize 1.9.0's Zeroizing has #[derive(Debug)] on a transparent tuple struct (zeroize-1.9.0/src/lib.rs:602-604), so any {:?}/dbg!/trace of the store prints all 32 seed bytes. With the seed an attacker forges/validates every seal, defeating tamper/rollback fail-closed protection; if callers pass node identity material it is a root secret leak. Fix: manual redacted Debug impl (print only whether a seed is present). Note: GatewayOscoreSenderStore/GatewayOscoreRecipientStore in lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs share the same pattern — file a follow-up there or fix in same pass. Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
